name: Love Songs♪ADV: Futaba Riho 14-sai ~Natsu~
original_name: LoveSongs♪アドベンチャー 双葉理保14歳〜夏〜
source:
Riho has been active in the entertainment industry since she was only 4 years old, but after being involved in an unfortunate kidnapping incident, she retired from the entertainment world and went to live in a small rural town in the island of Kyushu. The player takes a role of a rookie manager working at a talent scouting agency, looking for the next new talent. While there are many girls you will interact with, the focus of the story will be Riho once you get to meet her. However, persuading her to return to the entertainment scene might prove difficult due to her traumatic experience she has undergone as a child.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/ps2/love-songs-adv-futaba-riho-14-sai-natsu]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
Riho从4岁起就活跃在娱乐圈，但在卷入不幸的绑架事件后，她退出娱乐圈，前往九州岛的一个乡村小镇生活。玩家扮演在人才搜寻机构工作的新秀经理的角色，寻找下一个新人才。虽然你会与很多女孩互动，但一旦你见到里穗，故事的焦点将是她。然而，由于她小时候经历过的创伤经历，说服她重返娱乐圈可能会很困难。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/ps2/love-songs-adv-futaba-riho-14-sai-natsu]MobyGames[/url]]
